## Architecture facts (established)
- `packages/protocols/` gitignored (.gitignore:17). Private code resolved by absolute path via RHEMA_PROTOCOLS_PATH (.pnpmfile.cjs → link:). Stub `packages/protocols-stub` (name @rhema/protocols) is the public fallback; public-safe CI builds stub-only.
- Stub exports the manifest TYPES (PhaseManifest, WorkflowManifest, PhaseClass), PROTOCOLS_VERSION, fixtureManifest, IS_PROTOCOLS_STUB. Real pkg must export a superset (engine/harness build against whichever resolves).
- PhaseManifest fields (stub, from §12.2): key,index,label,skillPhase,seat(AgentTypeKey),artifacts[],predicates[],sidecars[],gateAfter?,optional?(Rigor),phaseClass,parallelGroup?,maxIterations?,budgetShare,backEdges?,allowsSubagents.
- P0.02 sidecar schemas to validate against (packages/contracts/src/sidecars.ts): findings.json, 01-claim-ledger.json, rubric.json, structure-plan.json, response-ledger.json, cut-list.json. SIDECAR_REGISTRY maps filename→{schema,anchorBearing}. severitySchema explicit in findings (REQ-SPEC-4). Anchor verbatim (REQ-OBJ-16).
- Enums: AgentTypeKey = author|editor|assistant|persona_builder|system (vocab.ts). WorkflowKey includes review,revise,fact_check,profile_voice,refresh_voice,calibrate_voice. GateKind incl approve_scope,approve_triage,approve_sample. RubricDimension = 8.
- DB `protocols` table (misc.ts): {id,version,body(jsonb),seededAt,venueTableVerifiedAt}. Essay seed = body(Protocol §6.7) + venue_table_verified_at.
- Upstream skills present: editorial-review, respond-to-review, bootstrap-persona, draft-from-outline. **Port only the first 3** (draft/outline/research deferred → P1.10/11/12). fact_check = manifest subset of editorial-review (REQ-WF-13), NOT a separate skill dir.

## §12.2 manifest facts
- Review order = skill fallback 0,4,1,2,5,3,6 = intake,craft,verification,discourse,second_read,argument,letter. Manifest `index` IS that order.
- Judge-class phases allowsSubagents:false (intake,argument,craft,second_read + fidelity audit,gap check,calibration). Hook rejects Agent in them.
- Back-edges: Draft grounding→plan (n/a here); Revise revise→triage (present).
- gateAfter: Review confirm scope after intake (approve_scope); Revise approve_triage after triage; Draft approve_plan; Profile approve_sample after census.
- Completion oracle (REQ-SPEC-13): (a) result subtype success, (b) phase-result.json {status:done}, (c) per-artifact predicate. Predicates as manifest DATA (REQ-ARCH-6/REQ-SPEC-13 data half): claim rows ≥ inventory; letter sections complete; second read producer-checked; response-ledger one row per finding.
- Estimator shapes (provisional): Review a≈40,b≈0.012,c≈24 (+discourse +90+0.006w, +second read +0.005w); Revise a≈50,b≈0.03,c≈4,d≈20; Fact-check 20+11·claims; Profile Quick 40+0.012w, Full 120+0.009·words_read+40·pieces_read+90·holdouts. Model mult 1/2.2/4.5.

## §6.7 Protocol / Essay
- Protocol type: id,version,name,tagline,variants[],rubric{dimensions[8],swaps?,caps},venue_bar{kind,table?,prompt},phase_defaults{verification,discourse,second_read,grounding,audit,stage,line_depth},calibration_language{verdicts[],reviewer_voice},length_norms{unit,default?,from_venue?,apparatus},integrity_norms{machine_may_not_supply[],disclosure_artifact?,exclusivity_reminder?,web_fetch_of_user_data},intake_expectations{typical_inputs[],entry_default},workflow_availability(Record),user_editable[].
- Essay: variants long-form(default)·newsletter-short; rubric the 8, letter leads with Voice & audience fit + Originality; venue_bar own-archive or named venue; phase_defaults all on, stage:infer; verdicts publish·revise·rethink; length voice regimes, apparatus none/light; integrity none platform-level, web_fetch_of_user_data allowed; intake notes-or-nothing/chat; user_editable venue,length,phase_defaults,stage.
